title: Views & Architecture-Mid Century on Mountain
description: This spectacular mid century modern house is nestled in the Phoenix Mountain Parks Preserve on Shaw Butte. Designed by celebrated architect Paul Christian Yeager, this magnificent home has Frank Lloyd Wright influences throughout. The top floor is yours to enjoy, with its own private entrance, kitchenette with refrigerator, microwave, coffee pot, sunken bathtub, comfortable beds, and mountain and downtown Phoenix views. Celebrate your special occasion here!Permit STR-2024-001528, TPT #21148058.The spaceThis amazing house combines unbelievable architecture with stunning mountainside views.  Sit on your private deck and watch the sunset, and then the lights of the city and downtown Phoenix twinkling below.  You are literally nestled in the mountainside, just underneath Shaw Butte.  Walk right from our driveway up the many Phoenix Mountain Parks Preserve trails.  Please be advised that due to being located on a mountainside and on the second story,  as well as easy access to the roof, this house is not suitable for children under 12 years of age.Guest accessYou will be able to park at top of driveway, and have private access to the upper floor of the house via the outer stairway. However, if you would like suggestions on where to sightsee, help with any travel issues, restaurant recommendations, or anything else, we would love to assist you in any way.  The kitchenette has basic utensils, refrigerator, microwave, coffee pot,  hot plate, etc., but is not a full kitchen.  Upon prior arrangements, hosts may give access to full kitchen downstairs.Other things to noteWe know what most people enjoy while traveling, and we will do our best to help you in any way.  We do live on a mountain, so you can expect to see our resident roadrunner, quail, hawks, family of foxes and other wildlife while you are here.  You can hike to the historic Cloud Nine restaurant ruins and Shaw Butte summit right from our driveway.  Also, if you are an architecture buff, ask us about our "Wright Tour, Right Guide: Architectural Tour of Mid Century Modern Phoenix Sites."  I can steer you towards fun local events, free activities, out of the way sightseeing adventures, rare Crested Saguaros, little known museums, specialized tours, and fun places to celebrate your special occasions!
